spans.s: Becalm,Ⓒv. t.ⒹnirvAta a. kf 8 U, praSam c. (Samayati); See Calm.

Because,Ⓒconj.Ⓓiti, hi (not at the beginning of a statement); yataH, yat; more oft. ex. by kutaH, kasmAt with abl.; by abl. or instr.; ‘b(ecause) he is liable to the charge of inequality and cruelty’ (neSvaro jagataH kAraRamupapadyate) kutaH vEzamyanErGfRyaprasaMgAt ‘b(ecause) of’ ex. by instr. or abl.; hetoH, kAraRAt; ‘b(ecause) of this’ iti hetoH.

Beck,Ⓒs.ⒹsaMjYA; saMketaH.
Ⓝ[Beck]on,Ⓒv. t.ⒹSirasA-hastena saMjYAM-saMketaM dA 3 U.
Ⓑ
 2 saMjYayA Ahve 1 P.

Become,Ⓒv. i.ⒹBU 1 P, saMpad 4 A; vft 1 A, jan 4 A; in majority of adjectives ex. by nouns with gam, prAp &c.; ‘became dejected’ vizAdaM gataH, vizaRRo baBUva; ‘b(ecome)s hated’ dvezyatAM yAti; ‘became amazed’ vismayamApede; ‘b(ecom)ing curious’ samupajAtakutUhalaH; ‘what became of the queen Sita’ sItAdevyAH kiM vfttaM (

), kimaBavat.
Ⓔv. t.Ⓓyuj pass., upapad 4 A, (with loc.); gen. ex. by anurUpa, sadfSa (SI f.), ucita, upapanna (all with gen.); ‘does this b(ecome) thy matted hair’ kimidaM jawAnAmanurUpaM, yukta-sadfSaM &c.
Ⓝ[Becom]ing,Ⓒa.Ⓓucita, anurUpa, yukta, upapanna; ‘it is b(ecoming)’ sAMprataM.
Ⓝ[Becom]ingly,Ⓒadv.ⒹyaTocitaM, yaTArhaM, yuktaM, anurUpaM.
